def max_expression_value(s):
    def evaluate(expression):
        return eval(expression)
    
    max_value = float('-inf')
    n = len(s)
    
    for i in range(1, n, 2):
        left = s[:i]
        right = s[i+1:]
        for j in range(1, len(right), 2):
            expr1 = f"({left}){s[i]}({right[:j]})"
            expr2 = f"({left}){s[i]}{right[:j]}"
            expr3 = f"{left}{s[i]}({right[:j]})"
            expr4 = f"{left}{s[i]}{right[:j]}"
            
            max_value = max(max_value, evaluate(expr1), evaluate(expr2), evaluate(expr3), evaluate(expr4))
    
    return max_value

# Read input from stdin
import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().strip()

# Print the result
print(max_expression_value(input))
